title: The Lake Below
subject: Water
Alpine
Landscape
description: A turquoise alpine lake appears between the forest and rock far below Appenzell.
alt: Distant turquoise alpine lake surrounded by green forest and steep gray cliffs in Appenzell, Switzerland.

title: The Biker
subject: Beach
People
description: A cyclist carries a mint-green surfboard across Praia da Baleia.
travel_note: It was one of those weekends at my cousin's beach house where everything felt like clockwork. Then this guy rode by and I remember thinking, if I were him, I'd want this picture.
alt: Cyclist carrying a mint-green surfboard across Praia da Baleia with ocean and island behind him.

title: Between Walls
subject: Architecture
description: Blue, coral and violet walls stack against the sky at La Muralla Roja.
travel_note: I found this place online while I was sitting in a hotel in Malta. We flew to Valencia, drove to Calpe and rented an apartment just so we could get inside.
alt: Blue, coral and violet geometric walls and stairways at La Muralla Roja in Calpe, Spain.

title: Before Summer
subject: Beach
Landscape
description: A weathered dune fence runs toward an almost-empty Ditch Plains beach.
travel_note: I was already tired and ready to drive home around 7. Then I thought, I'm already in Montauk, I might as well keep going. Ditch Plains was almost completely empty.
alt: Dune fence running toward a mostly empty beach at Ditch Plains in Montauk, New York.

title: Man and Dog
subject: Street
People
Animals
description: A man sits on a stone ledge in Florence beside his sleeping dog.
travel_note: This was one of the first street photographs I ever took. I remember debating whether I should ask him first, and then I just took the picture. I never really looked back after that.
alt: Man seated on a stone ledge beside a sleeping dog against a weathered wall in Florence, Italy.

title: Under the Limestone
subject: Water
People
Landscape
description: A woman rests beneath a huge limestone overhang on the coast of Gozo.
alt: Woman sitting beneath a large sculpted limestone overhang beside the sea in Gozo, Malta.

title: Rio Runner
subject: Beach
People
description: A runner crosses Ipanema with Dois Irmãos and the city fading into sea mist.
travel_note: I actually liked another frame from this scene first, without the runner. Then I kept coming back to this one and realized he was what made the whole picture.
alt: Runner crossing Ipanema beach with Dois Irmãos and Rio buildings fading into sea mist.

title: The Swimmer
subject: Water
People
Architecture
description: A swimmer moves through the pool below striped umbrellas and the Mediterranean.
travel_note: We were halfway through lunch when I realized I might never be here again. I got up from the table and started taking pictures.
alt: Swimmer in a bright blue pool below striped umbrellas at Mezzatorre in Ischia, Italy.

title: Grey Day
subject: Beach
Water
People
description: Beachgoers dot a grey afternoon in Moraira with small bursts of color.
alt: Crowded beach in Moraira, Spain on a grey day with colorful chairs and pale blue water.

title: Foggy Cows
subject: Alpine
Animals
Landscape
description: Two cows stand in dense fog on a mountain trail above Mürren.
travel_note: I lost both of my contacts in the rain, couldn't see properly and ended up surrounded by cows in the fog. I wasn't even sure if cows were dangerous, so I just stood there and waited.
alt: Two cows standing on a foggy mountain trail near Mürren, Switzerland.

title: Dune Lines
subject: Desert
Landscape
description: Wind draws repeating lines across the dunes of Paracas.
travel_note: This trip almost didn't happen. We basically cancelled it on a FaceTime call at five in the morning. The next day my friend called and said, "Did you buy your ticket to Peru?"
alt: Wind-formed repeating lines across golden sand dunes in Paracas, Peru.

title: Everyone In
subject: Water
People
Landscape
description: Swimmers jump, dive and gather around the limestone basin at St. Peter's Pool.
travel_note: This was the first place we went in Malta. I spent the day jumping into the water like a little kid. It was the best kind of organized chaos.
alt: Crowds swimming, diving and sunbathing around the limestone basin at St. Peter's Pool in Malta.

title: Christ in Fog
subject: Architecture
description: Christ the Redeemer nearly disappears into dense fog above Rio.
travel_note: It rained almost the entire trip, so this wasn't the Rio we thought we were coming to see. I'm glad now. I might never see Christ like this again.
alt: Christ the Redeemer seen from below and partially obscured by dense fog in Rio de Janeiro.

title: Pink Lagoon
subject: Water
Desert
Landscape
description: Pink salt water stretches across the pale desert in Paracas.
travel_note: We found this place on Google while we were driving around the reserve. One of my friends insisted that we stop wandering and go straight there. After that, we basically spent the day chasing whatever looked coolest.
alt: Pink salt lagoon surrounded by pale desert beneath a deep blue sky in Paracas, Peru.

title: Moraira from Above
subject: Beach
Water
Landscape
description: A curved beach and hillside houses wrap around the water in Moraira.
alt: Elevated view of a curved beach, hillside houses and pale blue water in Moraira, Spain.

title: Fishing Bay
subject: Water
Landscape
description: Fishing boats scatter across turquoise water beside the desert coast of Paracas.
travel_note: By then Paracas was starting to feel repetitive, but we kept driving anyway and found this little fishing port. It was one of the first moments I felt like we were actually traveling instead of just sightseeing.
alt: Fishing boats scattered across turquoise water beside a desert shoreline in Paracas, Peru.

title: Ipanema at Dusk
subject: Beach
Water
People
Landscape
description: Ipanema fills with people, mist and late sun as the mountains fade behind the beach.
travel_note: This was exactly the Rio I had imagined before I ever went. I was there with the family who made Brazil feel like home to me, and I still feel like I didn't get to stay in that moment long enough.
alt: Crowded Ipanema beach at dusk with Dois Irmãos, palms and warm haze in Rio de Janeiro.

title: After the Fog
subject: Alpine
Landscape
description: A narrow road runs through green pasture toward the mountains after the weather clears.
travel_note: Not long before this I had lost both contacts in the rain and was surrounded by cows. Then the fog cleared and Switzerland suddenly looked exactly like the postcard.
alt: Narrow paved road through green Swiss pasture leading toward snow-covered mountains near Mürren.

title: Perigo
subject: Beach
Signs + Objects
description: A red PERIGO sign stands alone against a purple-grey beach at dusk.
travel_note: I wasn't planning to shoot that day. The sky suddenly went purple, I grabbed my camera, and this red sign looked like it belonged to the whole scene.
alt: Red PERIGO warning sign on Praia da Baleia at dusk with waves and a dark headland behind it.

title: Appenzell Valley
subject: Alpine
Landscape
description: Green hills, roads and scattered houses unfold below the cable car in Appenzell.
alt: Rolling green hills, scattered houses and dramatic clouds in Appenzell, Switzerland.

title: First Bells
subject: Alpine
Animals
Landscape
description: A black-and-white cow grazes on Mount Rigi as the rest of the herd disappears into mist.
travel_note: I heard the bells before I could see anything. Then the fog opened up and there was this whole herd of cows on the hillside.
alt: Black-and-white cow grazing on a misty hillside at Mount Rigi, Switzerland, with more cows behind it.

title: Red Rooms
subject: Architecture
description: Red walls, plants and open corridors frame the sea at La Muralla Roja.
alt: Geometric red walls, corridors and plants at La Muralla Roja overlooking the sea in Calpe, Spain.

title: Blue Edge
subject: Water
Architecture
Landscape
description: A concrete platform points toward an uninterrupted blue horizon on Gozo.
alt: Concrete platform facing deep blue sea and a wide blue sky in Gozo, Malta.

title: Narrow Opening
subject: Water
Landscape
description: The limestone inlet at Wied il-Għasri opens into the Mediterranean.
travel_note: My friend stopped for coffee and I kept walking. I followed a couple toward the water and found this view that he never even saw.
alt: Limestone cliffs and a narrow inlet opening into the Mediterranean at Wied il-Għasri in Gozo, Malta.

title: Carousel
subject: Street
People
Signs + Objects
description: A carousel turns into bands of light at night in Florence.
travel_note: My dad had just given me the camera and we were basically messing around with the settings. We both saw this one and immediately thought it was cool. It ended up becoming one of the most unique photos I've taken.
alt: Long-exposure carousel glowing at night in Florence, Italy, with people seated nearby.

title: Low Tide
subject: Beach
Water
Landscape
description: Wet sand reflects a dark headland at low tide.
travel_note: I was walking the beach with my family and friends, but everyone kept moving and I stayed behind. I was just watching the water, the sand and the foam washing up, and this pattern caught me.
alt: Dark wet sand reflecting a headland and scattered sea foam at low tide on Praia da Baleia, Brazil.

title: Ipanema Promenade
subject: Street
People
Beach
description: A vendor works beneath the palms with Ipanema beach and Dois Irmãos behind him.
travel_note: This was the first moment I fell in love with Rio. I was walking with my cousins and saw this guy working with the palms, mist, beach and mountains behind him. It felt like I'd walked into a movie.
alt: Palm-lined Ipanema promenade with a vendor, beachgoers and Dois Irmãos in Rio de Janeiro.

title: On Dry Land
subject: Signs + Objects
Landscape
description: An orange life ring hangs alone against pale limestone in Gozo.
alt: Orange life ring mounted in a black metal frame against pale limestone in Gozo, Malta.

title: Red Car
subject: Water
People
Signs + Objects
Landscape
description: A red car and a few scuba divers sit above a rough limestone inlet in Gozo.
travel_note: We found this place by accident and watched people casually climb down into the water to scuba dive. It felt completely foreign to us and completely normal to them.
alt: Red car and scuba divers above a rocky limestone inlet with dark blue water in Gozo, Malta.

title: Playa Roja
subject: Beach
Water
Desert
Landscape
description: Red sand sits between rust-colored cliffs and green-blue water at Playa Roja.
travel_note: This was one of the first moments in Peru when all of us thought, okay, this trip was worth it. We could pull over almost anywhere in the reserve and just run out into the desert.
alt: Red sand beach below rust-colored cliffs and blue-green water at Playa Roja in Paracas, Peru.
